scope: Verbatim guide initialization followed by a separate harness that creates one synthetic SDK span, disposes the runtime, force-flushes and shuts down. The receiver is a same-origin loopback-only stub, not Langfuse or MLflow. No galaxie graph executes in this scratch probe.

harness.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
harness.singleApiResolution: Vite resolve.dedupe and a scratch resolver select the scratch install API; bundle module roots are counted directly. Linked galaxie packages use already built repository output.
harness.typecheck: TypeScript NodeNext with DOM, strict and skipLibCheck; only the exact guide.ts excerpt is typechecked. The appended probe harness is bundled by Vite.
harness.runtimeAppendix: provider.getTracer('scratch-guide-probe').startSpan('scratch-synthetic-span').end(); await runtime.dispose(); await provider.forceFlush(); await provider.shutdown();
